title: FlowContainer sorting should use float sizes instead of int
body:
### Tested versions

-Reproducible in 4.6

### System information

Godot v4.6.stable - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 Ti (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.9571) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i9-14900KF (32 threads) - 31.79 GiB memory

### Issue description

FlowContainers ignore the decimal part of their content's minimum size. This can cause alignment issues when the effect compounds over multiple items on a single line. For example, it can create a noticeable gap after the last item on the line.

In the video below, I have created an HFlowContainer that contains a large number of ColorRects. When I multi-select all of the ColorRects, and gradually change their size, the alignment noticeably jumps whenever I get to the next whole number. I think this is a bug. I would expect the alignment to gradually change as I increase their size by a decimal amount.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a5d16d61-427c-41db-9ee7-51b5e21f8e97

### Steps to reproduce

1. Create a FlowContainer and set its anchor/offset to Full Rect
2. Add many small but visible items to a FlowContainer
3. Gradually change the width of the FlowContainer's contents via the inspector. Notice how the alignment "jumps" whenever the size passes a whole number.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

This MRP just contains the setup as described above. To see the issue, manually adjust the minimum size of all ColorRects in the FlowContainer.
[flow-container-alignment-bug.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/26097317/flow-container-alignment-bug.zip)
